name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: An asymmetric grid of black feature cards, each pairing a small visual with an icon, title and description. Two wide cards and two narrow ones form a bento layout that reacts to hover.
use: Presenting four different product strengths side by side with a small visual for each.
avoid: A uniform grid: each card needs a span class, so equal sizing takes source edits.
a11y: Nothing here is operable, so keyboard and focus do not apply; the preview visuals are plain divs. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A four-cell bento of black rounded cards: a wide top-left card with a tiny terminal and purple glow, a narrow top-right with a code snippet, a bottom-left card with coloured tiles, and a wide bottom card showing two small light and dark UI panels on a grey gradient.
behaves: Static at rest. Hovering a card slides its icon and text right, adds a shadow and runs small changes inside: the purple glow brightens, the coloured tiles resize, and the two panels tilt apart.
customise: Each cell takes a title, description, header node, icon node and className for its span; grid columns and row height are set on the container.
weight: light: Four CSS grid cells with hover transitions only; no scripted animation.
